meta.tip_source: svt.one jitoReward / leaderSlotsDone, per validator per epoch
meta.gbx_note: GBX counts only blocks produced AFTER each validator's first_progress_event_time; 26413 pre-connection blocks are excluded from the GBX curve (they remain in the all-validator baseline). Comparator groups use all of August.
meta.window_matched_note: 'Agave Jito (window-matched)' reweights the cohort's epochs to GBX's post-connection epoch mix, removing the calendar difference. It moves the mean by under 0.5%%, so the plain cohort comparison is sound.
meta.tip_caveat: jitoReward is the validator's POST-COMMISSION take, so tips are understated wherever MEV commission is below 100%. Network tip share reads 5.9% here against 18.4% measured from on-chain tip-account inflows. BCJ, Cogent51 and ssx2rHZN run 0% MEV commission and contribute zero tips despite capturing ~180 SOL in August. Applied identically to all validators, so relative ranking holds far better than the absolute level. Tips are an epoch constant, so curve shape is fee shape.
meta.harmonic_modes: Harmonic scheduler mode from the operator list: MREV, FBA, FIFO. MREV is labelled Performance and FBA Balanced -- an inference, not vendor documentation, supported by MREV out-earning FBA independently in BOTH client families by the same +12.0% at p50 (+6.5%/+6.7% mean, +17-19% p90). FIFO is one validator on 2,112 blocks and is not a usable scheduler result. 70 of 70 listed validators matched on pubkey.
meta.rollup_note: 'Harmonic Performance' and 'Harmonic Balanced' are cross-family roll-ups shown as chart curves only; they overlap the per-family rows, so they are kept out of the table.
